before.title: Climate Control LCD Pixel Fade and Dim Backlighting
before.description: The factory climate control head unit suffers from two well-documented age-related failures: the LCD display loses pixels (rows of segments go black, making temperature and fan speed unreadable) and the incandescent backlight bulbs burn out, leaving the unit dim or completely dark at night. The conductive rubber zebra strip between the PCB and LCD degrades over time, and the small bulbs behind the faceplate are not designed for the heat cycles they see.
before.solution: Remove the climate control unit (held in by trim clips and two screws) and either send it to a specialist like Tanin Auto Electronix for LCD/bulb refurbishment, or DIY the repair using a replacement LCD screen and LED bulb kit. The fix typically restores full functionality with a lifetime warranty from reputable rebuilders. Avoid generic 12V replacement bulbs as they produce uneven brightness compared to the rest of the dash.
symptoms: Missing or fading pixels on the climate control LCD
Dim or completely dark backlight on the HVAC display
Unable to read temperature setting or fan speed at night
Display ghosting or partial segments visible

proposal.title: Climate Control LCD Pixel Fade and Dim Backlighting
proposal.description: Direct SC owner discussions document two distinct climate-control display symptoms: LCD bleeding or blackening and failed backlight bulbs. A current third-party repair-service page specifically lists 1992-2000 SC300/SC400 units and separates LCD, OEM-style lighting and LED-conversion options. The complete exact SC400 manufacturer-communication inventory contains no matching Lexus condition bulletin, and the reviewed sources do not establish a degraded zebra strip, a generation-wide failure rate, or heat-cycle design failure as the cause.
proposal.solution: First distinguish an LCD defect from failed bulbs, power, dimmer, connector or control-unit faults. For confirmed internal display or lighting work, use a qualified electronics repairer and verify the unit’s year group before replacement or exchange; the live Tanin listing is one exact mail-in service option, not an au7o endorsement. Confirm its current price, shipping, exclusions and warranty in writing because the page contains different warranty statements. Attempt soldering only with appropriate electronics skill and documentation. This proposal retains one exact live repair-service deep link but approves no universal LCD, bulb, LED kit or replacement control unit.
